name: YOMI-Bench
description: We propose YOMI-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating kanji reading and phonological understanding of large language models (LLMs) for Japanese. In Japanese, a single kanji character often has multiple possible readings, making it difficult to infer the correct reading from surface-level text alone. Due to these linguistic characteristics, it is empirically known that LLMs exhibit low performance in kanji reading for Japanese. The proposed YOMI-Bench consists of four tasks specifically designed to evaluate kanji reading performance in Japanese.
